highlights.description: SQL-wire `Client` for remotes, push/pull/fetch, and active branch — zero added driver dependencies, the caller supplies the `*sql.DB`
CLI-exec bootstrap (`Clone`, `InitDir`) and backup (`BackupAdd`, `BackupSync`, `BackupRestore`) operations for the cold path

added.description: `New(db *sql.DB) *Client` wraps an existing connection to a `dolt sql-server`
`Client.RemoteAdd`, `Client.RemoteRemove`, `Client.Remotes` — register, remove, and list configured remotes via `CALL DOLT_REMOTE(...)`
`Client.Push`, `Client.Pull`, `Client.Fetch` — sync against a remote via `CALL DOLT_PUSH`/`DOLT_PULL`/`DOLT_FETCH`
`Client.ActiveBranch` — the connection's active branch via `SELECT active_branch()`
Argument validation (`quotable`) rejects characters that could escape a single-quoted SQL literal
`Clone(ctx, remoteURL, dir)` and `InitDir(ctx, dir, name, email)` — CLI-exec bootstrap operations for when no server exists yet
`Available()` reports whether the `dolt` CLI is on `PATH`
`BackupAdd`, `BackupSync`, `BackupRestore` — named backup targets, snapshot/sync, and restore; no `DOLT_BACKUP` stored procedure exists, so these are CLI-exec only

documentation.description: README with installation, usage examples, and a full API reference table
MkDocs site (mirroring gogit's structure) with a Releases section for version history
README badges for CI, lint, SAST, godoc, MkDocs, visualization, and license status

build.description: Shared CI workflows: Go CI (test matrix across Linux/macOS/Windows), Go Lint (golangci-lint), Go SAST (CodeQL), and Dependabot config
.gitignore for mkdocs build output and local env files

internal.description: Removed the unused `status` result from `Client.call` (golangci-lint unparam) — every caller already relied on `call` turning a nonzero status into an error internally
